readerCopy.body: Uncertainty about what comes next can make a familiar option or beautiful possibility look more meaningful than the evidence supports. When Neptune squares the North Node, imagination and forward movement create friction, making nostalgia, mixed signals, or a vague promise difficult to distinguish from a direction worth choosing. The answer does not have to be forced out of an unclear situation. A small decision that produces evidence can narrow the story more effectively than waiting for the story to become certain first.
